units.title: 无鬼无气·占婚：官鬼无形而有用，卦中不可无，宜静不宜动；占婚无鬼婚难成，纵成夫当夭折

rule.yi: 官鬼这一爻没有形体却有用处，卦里不能没有，宜静不宜动；带吉神动也能有福，加凶煞动没有不成祸的。占婚姻而卦中没有官鬼，婚事难成，即使成了，丈夫也会早死。
rule.en: Pressure has no form but has its use; it must not be absent from the hexagram, and should be still and not move; moving with a lucky spirit it can also bring fortune, moving with a fierce star it always brings calamity. In a marriage divination with no Pressure in the hexagram, the marriage is hard to make, and even if it is made the husband will die young.

en: As for Pressure,
it has no form yet has its use;
it must not be absent from the hexagram,
it should be still and not move.
moving with a lucky spirit,
it can also bring fortune;
moving with a fierce star,
it never fails to bring calamity.

yi: 占婚姻而卦中没有官鬼，
en: In a marriage divination with no Pressure in the hexagram,
the marriage is hard to make;
even if it is made,
the husband will die young.

units.title: 绝处逢生·占婚：世应绝处逢生，事将解而后成，意先淡而后浓；男女两家贫乏无力得人扶策亦可成

rule.yi: 用爻遇绝，却有一个生它的爻发动来生，又变得有用，叫绝处逢生。占婚姻遇到世爻、应爻绝处逢生：事情快要散的时候又成了，心意先淡后浓；或者可以说男女两家贫乏无力，但得到人扶助，这件事也能成。
rule.en: A line that meets extinction but has a moving line generate it becomes useful again: this is birth in a place of extinction. In a marriage divination, if Self and Other meet birth in a place of extinction, the matter is about to fall apart and then is made, and the intent is at first cool and then warm; or it may be said that the two families are poor and powerless but helped and supported by someone, the matter can still be made.

zh: 且如申日占，卦遇用爻属木，
木见申则绝，木爻无用矣。
若得水爻发动，水长生动来相生，木爻仍复有用。
譬如人当困穷之际，得遇贵人扶持，
必有寒谷回春之象，此乃是绝处逢生也。
yi: 比如在申日占卦，卦里遇到的用爻属木，
木遇到申就绝了，木爻没有用了；
如果有水爻发动，水在申长生，动来相生，木爻又重新有用了。
就像人在穷困的时候，遇上贵人扶持，
一定有寒谷回春的样子，这就是绝处逢生。
en: Suppose the divination is on a Shen day and the Subject line is Wood:
Wood meets Shen and is cut off, and the Wood line is of no use;
this is the same as having none.
But if a Water line moves, Water being born at Shen and coming to generate it, the Wood line is useful again.
It is like a person at a time of poverty and hardship who meets a noble patron's help:
there is surely the look of spring returning to a cold valley; this is 'meeting life where there was severance'.

zh: 或可言男女家贫乏无力，
yi: 遇到世爻、应爻绝处逢生，
或者可以说男女两家贫乏无力，
en: Divining a marriage:
if Self and Other meet birth in a place of extinction,
the matter is about to fall apart and then is made,
and the intent is at first cool and then warm.
It may also be said that the two families are poor and powerless,
but helped and supported by someone,
the matter can still be made.

units.title: 合处逢冲·占婚：六合的卦被日辰冲，占婚必被人说破、两边相毁，将成而解

rule.yi: 六爻相合的卦，遇到日辰冲世应，叫合处逢冲。占婚姻遇到：一定被人说破，两边互相诋毁，快成的时候又散了。
rule.en: A hexagram whose lines all combine but whose Self or Other line is clashed by the Day is a combination meeting a clash. In a marriage divination, meeting this, the match is sure to be talked to pieces by others, both sides slander each other, and what is about to be made falls apart.

zh: 世应相生，六爻相合，吉无不利，乃事事可成之象也。
yi: 世应相生，六爻相合，吉利没有不顺的，是事事可成的样子。
子冲应爻上的午、又害世爻上的未，
en: Suppose the divination gets the Yu hexagram, Thunder over Earth.
Self and Other generate each other and the six lines combine; all is auspicious and nothing goes against it; it is the look of everything succeeding.
But it is got on a Zi day,
and Zi clashes the Wu on the Other line and harms the Wei on the Self line;
this is 'meeting a clash where there was combination'.

yi: 会看到快成的时候又散了。
en: In a marriage divination, meeting this,
it is sure to be talked to pieces by others,
both sides slander each other,
and what is about to be made falls apart.

units.title: 随官入墓·占婚：世随鬼入墓，男家贫乏、男财不备；三种入墓不问占何事皆非吉兆

rule.yi: 随官入墓有三种：卦身随鬼入墓、世爻随鬼入墓、本命随鬼入墓；这三种入墓，不管占什么事都不是吉兆。占婚姻遇到世爻随鬼入墓，男方家里贫乏，男方的钱财没有准备好。
rule.en: Following Pressure into the tomb comes in three kinds: the Body, the Self line, or the Life following Pressure into the tomb; whatever the matter divined, none of the three is a lucky sign. In a marriage divination, if Self follows Pressure into the tomb, the man's family is poor and the man's wealth is not ready.

en: 'Following Pressure into the tomb' has three kinds:
the Body following Pressure into the tomb,
the Self following Pressure into the tomb,
and the natal line following Pressure into the tomb.
Of these three tombs,
whatever is being divined,
none is an auspicious sign.

yi: 男方的钱财没有准备好。
en: In a marriage divination,
if Self follows Pressure into the tomb,
the man's family is poor,
and the man's wealth is not ready.

units.title: 逢冲暗动·占婚：吉则暗中有人网维、凶则暗中有人破说

rule.yi: 六爻安静的卦，被日辰冲而动，叫暗动；暗动有吉有凶，各有各的用处，不可一概而论。占婚姻遇到暗动：吉的话暗中有人维系撮合；凶的话暗中有人说破。
rule.en: In a hexagram whose six lines are still, a line stirred by the Day's clash is a hidden movement; hidden movement brings good or ill, each with its own use, and cannot be judged all the same. In a marriage divination, meeting hidden movement, if lucky someone quietly holds the match together; if unlucky someone quietly talks it apart.

zh: 且如六爻安静，不遇冲则不动。
各有所用焉，不可一概而论。
yi: 六爻都安静的时候，不遇到冲就不动。
如果被日辰冲到，叫作暗动。
各有各的用处，不能一概而论。
en: When the six lines are all quiet, without a clash they do not move.
If the Day clashes a line, it is called a hidden movement.
A hidden movement may be auspicious or ominous,
each with its own use, and not to be judged all alike.

yi: 吉的话，暗中有人维系撮合；
en: In a marriage divination, meeting it,
if lucky, someone quietly holds the match together;
if unlucky, someone quietly talks it apart.

units.title: 助鬼伤身·占婚：鬼克世而妻财动来生助，纵成其妇也不贤不孝公姑、搬唆夫主、割户分门、不和兄弟

rule.yi: 生助官鬼的只有妻财，不宜发动，动了就把弱的鬼变成旺鬼。卦中鬼爻克身世，妻财再动来生助，凶更重；没有财，凶有限；两个财都动，大凶。占婚姻遇到：世爻是男家，官鬼是丈夫，鬼克世是自己克自家，本来就不好；再遇财爻发动、生助鬼爻，即使成了，那个妻子也一定不贤、不孝敬公婆、挑唆丈夫、分家另过、不和兄弟。
rule.en: The only line that generates and supports Pressure is Wealth, and it should not move, for moving turns a weak ghost into a strong one. When the Pressure line in a hexagram controls the Body or Self and Wealth also moves to generate and support it, the ill is all the worse; with no Wealth the ill is limited; with two Wealth lines both moving the calamity is very great. In a marriage divination: Self is the man's family and Pressure is the husband, so Pressure controlling Self is a house controlling itself, which is not fine to begin with; if Wealth then moves and generates and supports Pressure, even if the match is made the wife will surely be unworthy, unfilial to her parents-in-law, egg her husband on, split the household and be at odds with his brothers.

zh: 生助官鬼者，不过妻财也。
yi: 能生助官鬼的，只有妻财。
一动，衰弱的鬼就变成旺鬼。
旺鬼再遇到它，来势更凶。
en: The only line that can generate and help Pressure is Wealth.
It should not move,
for once it moves a weak Pressure becomes a strong one.
A strong Pressure meeting it grows more fierce.

yi: 凡是卦中鬼爻克身世的，
en: Take a divination made on a Shen day that gives the hexagram Li:
Pressure sits on the Other line and controls Self,
which is not a fine omen to begin with;
and if Wealth also moves,
generating and supporting the Pressure line,
the ill is all the worse:
this is helping Pressure to harm the person.
Whenever the Pressure line in a hexagram controls the Body or Self,
if there is no Wealth,
the ill is limited;
if there are two Wealth lines and both move,
the calamity is very great.

zh: 必主其妇不贤不孝公姑，
yi: 那个妻子一定不贤惠、不孝敬公婆，
en: In a marriage divination, meeting this,
it is also not lucky.
Self is the man's family,
Pressure is the husband;
it controls its own house,
which is not fine to begin with;
and if Wealth then moves,
generating and supporting the Pressure line,
even if the match is made,
the wife will surely be unworthy and unfilial to her parents-in-law,
egg her husband on,
split the household and set up a separate door,
and be at odds with his brothers.

units.title: 父母用·占婚：父母爻为主婚人，空则必无主者及无聘礼

rule.yi: 父母爻是生我的，能吉能凶，各有各的用处：遇财就伤自身，遇鬼反而增光；发动就克伤子孙、生扶兄弟。占婚姻，父母爻是主婚人：空亡了，就一定没有人主婚，也没有聘礼。
rule.en: The Resource line is what generates me and can bring good or ill, each with its own use: meeting Wealth it harms its own body, meeting Pressure it grows in radiance; moving, it controls and harms Output and supports Peer. In a marriage divination the Resource line is the presider at the wedding; when it is Void there is surely no presider and no betrothal gifts.

en: The Resource line
is what generates me.
The Resource line
can bring ill,
can bring good,
each with its own use.
Meeting Wealth it harms its own body,
meeting Pressure it grows in radiance.
Moving, it controls and harms Output
and supports Peer.
Examine whether it is still or moving, weak or strong;
each has what suits it.

yi: 父母爻是主婚人，落空的话，
就一定没有人主婚，也没有聘礼。
en: Divining a marriage:
the Resource line is the presider at the wedding, and if it is Void,
there is surely no presider and no betrothal gifts.

note.yi: 「为主婚人空」原书没有标点，这里读作「为主婚人，空则……」。
note.en: The book has no punctuation in 'is the presider, Void', and it is read here as 'the presider; when Void, ...'.

units.title: 兄弟用·占婚：兄弟为费财、诡诈、虚妄；大象可成发动不过破财，不可成则临世发动他日伤妻，间爻动则媒人诡诈

rule.yi: 兄弟爻是与我五行相同的，不能带来福，也不至于大凶，不过是破败、克剥、阻滞之神；怕官鬼发动来制它，喜欢父母兴旺让它有依靠；发动就伤克妻财、扶持子孙。占婚姻，兄弟爻是耗费钱财、诡诈、虚妄：大象能成的，发动不过是破财；不能成的，兄弟临世发动，日后必伤妻；在间爻上发动，一定是媒人诡诈虚妄。
rule.en: Peer is what shares my element; it cannot bring fortune and cannot bring great ill, being nothing but the spirit of ruin, plunder and obstruction; it fears Pressure moving to hold it in check and is glad when Resource thrives and gives it support; moving, it injures and controls Wealth and supports Output. In a marriage divination Peer means expense, trickery and falsehood: if the overall image allows the match, its moving is no more than a loss of money; if it cannot be made, Peer moving on Self surely means the wife will be harmed some day, and moving on a between line means the go-between is tricky and false.

zh: 无非破败、克剥、阻滞之神也。
发动则伤克妻财、扶持福德。
yi: 与我五行相同的是兄弟。
不过是破败、克剥、阻滞的神。
发动就伤克妻财、扶持福德。
en: What shares my element is Peer.
In general it cannot bring fortune,
nor can it bring great ill;
it is nothing but the spirit of ruin, plunder and obstruction.
It fears Pressure moving,
and is then held in check;
it is glad to meet a thriving Resource line,
and then has something to lean on.
Moving, it injures and controls Wealth and supports Output.
Divining a marriage:
it means expense,
trickery,
and falsehood.
If the overall image allows it to be made,
moving it comes to no more than a loss of money;
if it cannot be made,
moving on Self,
it surely means the wife will be harmed some day;
if it moves on a between line,
the go-between is surely tricky and false.

units.title: 子孙用·占婚：子孙为子息，卦中无子必无儿，但不宜动，动则异日伤夫

rule.yi: 我所生的是子孙爻，是卦中最吉的神：遇到它没有不好的，背离它就没法带来福；卦里没有父母爻它就不受克，有兄弟爻它就有依靠；发动就生财、克伤官鬼。占婚姻，子孙爻代表子息：卦中没有子孙，一定没有儿子；但不宜发动，动了日后要伤夫。
rule.en: What I generate is the Output line, the most auspicious spirit in a hexagram: meeting it, all is fair, and whatever turns its back on it cannot bring fortune; with no Resource line in the hexagram it is not controlled, and with Peer among the lines it has support; moving, it generates Wealth and controls and harms Pressure. In a marriage divination the Output line stands for children: if there is no Output in the hexagram there will surely be no son; but it should not move, for moving it will harm the husband some day.

yi: 凡是我所生的是子孙爻。
卦里没有父母爻就不受克，
en: What I generate is Output.
It is the most auspicious spirit in a hexagram:
meeting it, all is fair,
and whatever turns its back on it cannot bring fortune.
With no Resource line in the hexagram it is not controlled,
with Peer among the lines it has support.
Moving, it generates Wealth
and controls and harms Pressure.
Divining a marriage:
the Output line stands for children.
If there is no Output in the hexagram,
there will surely be no son.
But it should not move:
moving, it will harm the husband some day.

units.title: 妻财用·占婚：财为妇，旺相临青龙吉星必女貌端正，不宜动，动则伤克公姑

rule.yi: 妻财是我所克的，诸事遇到都吉，只有占父母和文书时不宜见到它；遇兄弟受损，遇子孙更好，遇官鬼会泄我的气；动静都吉。占婚姻，妻财代表妻子：旺相、临青龙等吉星，女子相貌一定端正；不宜发动，动了就伤克公婆。
rule.en: Wealth is what I control, and in every matter meeting it is lucky, except that it is not welcome when divining for parents or documents; meeting Peer it suffers, meeting Output it is better still, meeting Pressure it drains my qi; still or moving, it is lucky. In a marriage divination Wealth stands for the wife: strong and on the Azure Dragon or another lucky star, the woman's looks are surely upright; it should not move, for moving it injures and controls the parents-in-law.

zh: 妻财者，我克者谓之妻财也。
惟占父母及文书，不宜见之。
yi: 妻财，就是我克的那个六亲。
各种事遇到它，没有不吉的；
只有占父母和文书时，不宜见到它；
en: Wealth is the relation that I control.
In all matters, meeting it is always auspicious;
only when divining about Resource, that is parents and documents, is it unwelcome;
meeting Peer it suffers loss,
meeting Output it is better still,
meeting Pressure it drains my qi.
Moving or still, it is auspicious.
Divining a marriage:
Wealth stands for the wife.
Strong and on the Azure Dragon or another lucky star,
the woman's looks are surely upright.
It should not move:
moving, it injures and controls the parents-in-law.

units.title: 官鬼用·妻占夫：官鬼凶多福少，怕子孙、靠妻财，卦中不可无，宜静不宜动；妻占夫以官鬼为用爻，旺相带青龙者聪明俊雅

rule.yi: 官鬼是克我的，大体上凶多福少，怕子孙、靠妻财，发动就伤克兄弟、生扶父母；卦中虽凶却不能没有，宜静不宜动。妻子占丈夫，官鬼是用爻：旺相带青龙的，一定是聪明俊雅的人；加贵人一定有职事，不然也是官宦人家的子弟；在胎、养、沐浴的爻上，如今虽是小官，日后必贵；最宜持世，或者临阳象，都叫得地。
rule.en: Pressure is what controls me; in general it brings more ill than fortune, fears Output and relies on Wealth; moving, it injures and controls Peer and supports Resource; though ill in a hexagram it must not be missing, and should be still and not move. When a wife divines a husband, Pressure is the Subject line: strong and carrying the Azure Dragon, he is surely an intelligent, handsome and refined man; with the Noble added he surely has a position, and otherwise he is at least a son of an official family; on a line at the Womb, Nurture or Bathing stage, though now a minor official he will surely be eminent some day; it is best holding Self or on a yang image, and either is called being in place.

zh: 官鬼者，克我者为官鬼也。
en: Pressure is what controls me.
In general it means more ill
and less fortune.
What it fears is Output;
what it relies on is Wealth.
Moving, it injures and controls Peer
and supports Resource.
Yet though it is ill in a hexagram,
it must not be missing,
but it should be still and not move.
A wife divining a husband:
it is the Subject line.

yi: 不然也是官宦人家的子弟。
如果在胎、养、沐浴的爻上，
en: Strong and carrying the Azure Dragon,
he is surely an intelligent, handsome and refined man.
With the Noble added he surely has a position;
otherwise he is at least a son of an official family.
If it is on a line at the Womb, Nurture or Bathing stage,
though now he is only a minor official,
some day he will surely be eminent.
It is best holding Self,
or on a yang image;
either is called being in place.

note.yi: 「胎、养、沐浴」是十二长生里的三个阶段，书里没有另外解释。
note.en: The Womb, Nurture and Bathing stages are three of the twelve life stages, which the book does not explain further.

units.title: 父母用变·婚姻：父母爻发动克子孙，婚姻子息应难得

rule.yi: 父母爻一发动就克子孙：病人无药、沉昏；婚姻和子息都难得；买卖劳心，利不存。
rule.en: When the Resource line moves it controls Output: a sick person has no medicine and sinks into stupor; marriage and offspring are hard to get; in trade, effort is spent and profit does not stay.

yi: 父母爻发动，当头克子孙，
病人没有药可用，昏沉不醒；
做买卖，劳心费力，没有利。
en: Resource moving and squarely controlling Output:
the sick have no medicine and sink into stupor;
marriage and offspring are hard to get;
in trade one wears out the mind and no profit remains.

note.yi: 这一句只有「婚姻子息应难得」说到婚姻，前后是病和买卖。
note.en: Only 'marriage and offspring are hard to get' speaks of marriage; the clauses around it are about illness and trade.

units.title: 子孙用变·婚姻：子孙发动伤官鬼，婚姻喜美是姻缘

rule.yi: 子孙爻发动伤克官鬼：占病求医身体就痊愈；行人、买卖身体安康；婚姻喜庆美满，是好姻缘。
rule.en: When the Output line moves it injures and controls Pressure: in illness and seeking a doctor the body recovers; travelers and trade are in good health; a marriage is happy and fair, a good match.

yi: 出门的人和做买卖的人，平安康泰；
婚姻喜庆美满，是好姻缘。
en: Output moving and harming Pressure:
in divining illness and seeking a doctor, the body is cured;
the traveller and the trader are safe and well;
a marriage is happy and fair, a good match.

note.yi: 子孙发动克官鬼，对占婚的女方是伤夫（见 LY.MARRY.TXF.07、LY.MARRY.DYTJ.09），这里说的却是「婚姻喜美」，是这首歌诀的口径。
note.en: Output moving to control Pressure is, for a woman divining a marriage, harm to the husband (see LY.MARRY.TXF.07 and LY.MARRY.DYTJ.09), yet this rhyme says 'a marriage is happy and fair'; that is the rhyme's own line.

units.title: 妻财用变·婚姻：财爻发动，亲姻如意乐无虞；财化财则妇主灾

rule.yi: 妻财爻发动克文书：考试求官都是虚的；买卖、结交官府的财吉利；婚姻亲事如意，快乐无忧。财化财，妇人有灾。
rule.en: When the Wealth line moves it controls documents: exams and seeking office come to nothing; trade and dealing with officials bring luck in money; marriage and family ties go as wished, glad and free of worry. Wealth changing into Wealth, the woman meets calamity.

yi: 做买卖、结交官府，对财有利；
婚姻亲事如意，快乐无忧。
en: The Wealth line moving and controlling the document line:
sitting exams and seeking office always come to nothing;
trading and dealing with officials favour the money;
marriages and family ties go as wished, glad and free of worry.
Wealth changing into Wealth, the woman meets calamity;

units.title: 兄弟用变·婚姻：兄弟交重克了财，买婢求妻事不谐

rule.yi: 兄弟爻交重克了财：病人难愈、灾未离；考试雷同是大忌；官非、暗贼耗钱财；若带吉神有助，出路的行人还没来，做买卖折本；买婢女、求妻，事情不和谐。
rule.en: When the Peer line moves and controls Wealth: a sick person is hard to cure and the calamity has not left; in exams sameness with others is a great taboo; lawsuits and hidden thieves drain money. If it carries a lucky spirit and helps, a traveler on the road has not yet come, trade loses its capital, and buying a maid or seeking a wife does not go smoothly.

yi: 官司和暗中的盗贼，耗损钱财。
如果带着吉神，就有帮助；
出门在外的人还没有回来；
en: Peer moving and controlling Wealth:
the sick are hard to cure and the calamity has not left;
in an exam, meeting the same rivals is a great taboo;
lawsuits and secret thieves waste money.
if it carries an auspicious spirit, there is help;
the traveller on the road has not yet come home;
goods and trade lose capital;
buying a maid or seeking a wife does not go smoothly.

note.yi: 这一首里只有最后一句说到婚姻（买婢、求妻）。
note.en: In this rhyme only the last clause speaks of marriage (buying a maid, seeking a wife).

units.title: 官鬼用变·婚姻：官鬼发动克兄弟，婚姻未就生滞疑

rule.yi: 官鬼爻发动克兄弟：婚姻还没成，生出停滞和疑虑；病困门庭，祸祟来到。
rule.en: When the Pressure line moves it controls Peer: a marriage not yet made meets delay and doubt; illness troubles the household and haunting misfortune comes.

yi: 婚姻还没成，生出停滞和疑虑；
en: Pressure moving and controlling Peer:
a marriage not yet made meets delay and doubt;

note.yi: 《易冒》《海底眼》等书里官鬼是婚姻的用爻，这首诗却说官鬼发动主婚姻停滞，要和 LY.MARRY.HZL.22 一起看。
note.en: In the Yi Mao and other books Pressure is the Subject for marriage, whereas this rhyme says Pressure moving means marriage delay; read it together with LY.MARRY.HZL.22.

units.title: 世应当中隔爻：两间爻发动则所求多阻隔，有气事分明而慢慢方得；兄弟动脱诈口舌、官鬼动人事乖隔；占婚姻间爻为媒

rule.yi: 世应当中的两个间爻发动，所求的事多有阻隔；间爻有气，事情就分明，但要慢慢才得。兄弟动是脱诈口舌，官鬼动是人事乖隔。占婚姻，间爻是媒人；占生产，是接生婆；占事，是阻隔；占种田，是农人；占宅，是邻里。
rule.en: When the two between lines in the middle of Self and Other move, what is sought meets many obstructions; if they have qi the matter is clear, but it is obtained only slowly. Peer moving means evasion, deceit and quarrels; Pressure moving means people and affairs at odds and cut off. In marriage a between line is the go-between; in childbirth the midwife; in an affair, obstruction; in farming, the farmer; for a house, the neighbors.

yi: 发动了所求的事多有阻隔；
en: The two between lines in the middle of Self and Other,
when they move, what is sought meets many obstructions;
if they have qi, the matter is clear,
but it is obtained only slowly.
Peer moving means evasion, deceit and quarrels;
Pressure moving means people and affairs at odds and cut off.
In marriage a between line is the go-between;
in childbirth the midwife;
in an affair, obstruction;
in farming, the farmer;
for a house, the neighbors.

units.title: 六爻俱静类：卦遇六爻安静须看用与日辰，日辰克用及冲刑宜谨慎，世应临用神及原神则昌盛；娶妻买妾用爻宜静、有气为先

rule.yi: 六爻全都安静的卦，要看用神和日辰：日辰克用神或者冲刑它，事情要谨慎；再推究世应，忌神千万不要加临，世应临用神和原神，做事一定昌盛。娶妻买妾、屋宅坟田、住庵谒人、失物理冤这些事，用爻宜静，有气为先。
rule.en: When all six lines of a hexagram are still, look at the Subject and the Day: if the Day controls, clashes with or punishes the Subject, the matter calls for caution; then examine Self and Other: the Adversary must on no account come upon them, and if Self and Other sit on the Subject and the Support spirit, the undertaking will certainly flourish. For taking a wife or buying a concubine, houses and graves, living in a hermitage or calling on people, lost property and righting a wrong, the Subject line should be still and having qi comes first.

yi: 日辰克用神，或者冲、刑它，
en: When a hexagram has all six lines still,
look at the Subject and the Day;
if the Day controls the Subject, or clashes with or punishes it,
the matter calls for caution.
Go on to examine Self and Other:
the Adversary must on no account come upon them;
if Self and Other sit on the Subject and the Support spirit,
the undertaking will certainly flourish
taking a wife or buying a concubine,
houses and graves and fields,
living in a hermitage, calling on people,
lost property, righting a wrong,
the Subject line should be still,
and having qi comes first.

note.yi: 第一段末尾原书有一个「（1）」，是指向今人注释的编号，不在译文里。「元辰」译作 Support spirit，即原神。
note.en: The book has a '(1)' at the end of the first passage, a number pointing to a modern note, which is left out of the translation. 'Yuan chen' is rendered as the Support spirit, the same as the original spirit.

units.title: 妻财独发：损书伤父，若乘旺相则婚姻可成

rule.yi: 妻财爻独自发动，会损文书、伤父母；如果乘旺相，婚姻可以成。
rule.en: When Wealth moves alone it harms documents and injures the parent; if it rides on strength, the marriage can be made.

en: Wealth moving alone
harms documents and injures the parent;
if it rides a thriving state,
the marriage can be made.

units.title: 占公私用事：官用取官、私用取财；占婚问夫看官爻，占婚姻事看财爻

rule.yi: 官用取官，私用取财。占病（鬼祟）、占失（看贼）、求官事、官司词讼、占婚姻问丈夫，这些都看官爻；占买卖、家事、奴婢事、求财事、婚姻事，这些都看财爻。
rule.en: For an official matter take Pressure, for a private matter take Wealth. Illness (haunting), loss (look for the thief), seeking office, lawsuits, and marriage when asking after the husband: all of these look at the Pressure line; trade, household affairs, servant matters, seeking wealth and marriage matters: all of these look at the Wealth line.

en: Yin and yang, man and woman, are laid out in order;
for public matters, take the Pressure line;
for private matters, take Wealth.
illness: look at haunting spirits,
loss: look for the thief,
seeking office,
official lawsuits,
marriage when asking after the husband,
all look to the Pressure line.
trade, look at Wealth,
household affairs,
servant matters,
seeking wealth,
marriage matters,
in all of these look at the Wealth line.

note.yi: 「占婚问夫」是女方占丈夫；「占婚姻事」没有写明男女，按上下文是一般的婚事，看财爻。
note.en: 'Marriage when asking after the husband' is a woman divining a husband; 'marriage matters' does not say man or woman and, from the context, is marriage in general, judged by the Wealth line.

units.title: 期日章·婚姻：婚姻本宫内外旺，或然月卦用为仪

rule.yi: 期日章说婚姻的应期：本宫内外卦旺的时候，或者以月卦为准。
rule.en: The chapter on days of fulfilment says of the timing of a marriage: when the home palace is strong, inner and outer, or else take the month hexagram as the standard.

yi: 婚姻的应期，本宫的内卦外卦旺相的时候，
en: For marriage, when the home palace is strong, inner and outer,
or else take the month hexagram as the standard.

note.yi: 这一句原书后面另有今人的「注释」逐句解释，本库不引。「仪」按上下文是准则。
note.en: In the book this line is followed by a modern gloss, which this library does not quote. 'Yi' is read from the context as a standard or measure.

units.title: 明六神诀·青龙：属木属阳，持世及交重者为财喜、为婚姻、为孕育、为姻亲，附于六爻无有不吉

rule.yi: 青龙属木、属阳，春天旺，亥月长生，卯月最旺，在未、申墓绝。它持世或发动，主财喜、婚姻、孕育、姻亲；附在哪一爻上都吉而亨通。
rule.en: The Azure Dragon belongs to Wood and is yang; it thrives in spring, is born at Hai, peaks at Mao, and is in the tomb and extinct at Wei and Shen. If it holds Self or moves, it means joy over wealth, marriage, pregnancy and in-law relations; attached to any of the six lines it is lucky and smooth.

zh: 附于六爻无有不吉而亨者也。
yi: 这个神如果持世或者发动，
附在六爻上，没有不吉利而亨通的。
en: The Azure Dragon belongs to Wood.
Zhen thrives and Xun is strong.
It thrives in spring,
is born at Hai,
peaks at Mao,
and is in the tomb and extinct at Wei and Shen;
it is yang.
If this spirit holds Self or moves,
it means joy over wealth,
marriage,
pregnancy,
and in-law relations.
Attached to any of the six lines, there is none that is not lucky and smooth.

units.title: 六神彖象歌·青龙入木：值旺来生世、不值空亡尽可为，求婚须得财须有

rule.yi: 青龙落在木爻上，旺相、来生世爻、不落空亡，做什么都可以；求婚要有财爻；占行人一定回来。
rule.en: With the Azure Dragon on a Wood line, strong and coming to generate Self and not meeting Void, all may be done; to seek a marriage Wealth must be present; asking after a traveler, he will surely return.

yi: 青龙入木，遇到旺相、来生世爻，
不遇到空亡，什么都可以做；
en: The Azure Dragon entering Wood, finding strength and coming to generate Self,
not meeting Void, all may be done;
to seek a marriage, Wealth must be present;
asking after a traveler, he will surely return.

units.title: 何知章·青龙：青龙进钱财，住宅婚姻进口来

rule.yi: 青龙进钱财，住宅和婚姻都会进人口来；出入求财大有所获，造作添修也没有灾。
rule.en: The Azure Dragon brings in money; for a house and for a marriage, people are added to the household; going in and out seeking wealth, one will gain greatly, and building or repairs bring no calamity.

yi: 住宅、婚姻，人口物件都进来；
出门入门求财，该有大收获；
en: The Azure Dragon brings in money;
for house and marriage, people and goods come in;
going out and coming in to seek wealth, there should be a great haul;
building and repairs meet no calamity.

note.yi: 「进口」是添人口：住宅添人口，婚姻娶进新人。
note.en: 'Bringing in mouths' means adding people to the household: for a house, more members; for a marriage, a new member brought in.

units.title: 神煞表·天月德、青龙：喜庆婚姻，求财合吉；公私吉庆，婚姻财吉

rule.yi: 神煞表按月排：天月德按月依次是丁、坤、壬、辛、乾、甲、癸、艮、丙、乙、巽、庚，主喜庆婚姻，求财也合吉；青龙按月依次是寅、卯、辰、巳、午、未、申、酉、戌、亥、子、丑，主公私吉庆，婚姻和财都吉。
rule.en: The table of spirit stars is laid out by month. The Heavenly-Month Virtue runs month by month as Ding, Kun, Ren, Xin, Qian, Jia, Gui, Gen, Bing, Yi, Xun, Geng, and means joyful events and marriage, and suits seeking wealth; the Azure Dragon runs month by month as Yin, Mao, Chen, Si, Wu, Wei, Shen, You, Xu, Hai, Zi, Chou, and means good fortune in public and private matters, with marriage and wealth both lucky.

zh: 天月德丁坤壬辛乾甲癸艮丙乙巽庚喜庆婚姻，
yi: 天月德（按月依次是丁、坤、壬、辛、乾、甲、癸、艮、丙、乙、巽、庚），喜庆婚姻，
en: Heavenly-Month Virtue (month by month: Ding, Kun, Ren, Xin, Qian, Jia, Gui, Gen, Bing, Yi, Xun, Geng): joyful events and marriage,
and it suits seeking wealth.

zh: 青龙寅卯辰巳午未申酉戌亥子丑公私吉庆，
yi: 青龙（按月依次是寅、卯、辰、巳、午、未、申、酉、戌、亥、子、丑），公私吉庆，
en: Azure Dragon (month by month: Yin, Mao, Chen, Si, Wu, Wei, Shen, You, Xu, Hai, Zi, Chou): good fortune in public and private matters,
marriage and wealth both lucky.

note.yi: 这两行是一张表里的两行，表头是「神煞 月令 一 二 三 …… 十二 说明」，十二个字依次对着正月到十二月；表格里的空白原文已压掉。
note.en: These two rows come from one table whose header reads 'spirit star, month, one, two, three, ... twelve, explanation', the twelve entries standing for the first to the twelfth month; the blank spaces of the table are squeezed out of the original text.

units.title: 四刑：寅申巳亥为四刑，凡作百事一无成，婚姻官事俱不吉，纵得相生也不宁

rule.yi: 寅、申、巳、亥是四刑：做什么事都不成，婚姻和官事都不吉，即使相生也不安宁（比如世爻寅、应爻申）。
rule.en: Yin, Shen, Si and Hai are the four punishments: in doing anything at all nothing is accomplished, marriage and official matters are both unlucky, and even if they generate each other there is no peace (for example, Self at Yin and Other at Shen).

yi: 做什么事都一件也不成；
即使得到相生，也不安宁。
en: Yin, Shen, Si and Hai are the four punishments;
in doing anything at all, nothing is accomplished;
marriage and official matters are both unlucky;
even if they generate each other there is no peace.

yi: 比如世爻是寅、应爻是申就是这样。
en: For example, Self at Yin and Other at Shen.

units.title: 鳏寡杀：春牛不下田、夏龙飞上天、秋羊草枯死、冬犬厌残年，婚姻遇发动不久

rule.yi: 鳏寡杀的口诀：春天的牛不下田，夏天的龙飞上天，秋天的羊草枯死，冬天的狗厌恶残年。婚姻遇到它发动，长久不了。
rule.en: The rhyme of the widower-and-widow star: in spring the ox does not go down to the field, in summer the dragon flies up to heaven, in autumn the goat's grass withers and dies, in winter the dog is weary of the dying year. In marriage, if it meets this star moving, it does not last.

yi: 婚姻遇到它发动，长久不了。
en: In spring the ox does not go down to the field,
in summer the dragon flies up to heaven,
in autumn the goat's grass withers and dies,
in winter the dog is weary of the dying year.
In marriage, if it meets this star moving, it does not last.

note.yi: 四句口诀里的牛、龙、羊、犬是生肖，依次对着丑、辰、未、戌四个地支，分别是春、夏、秋、冬的鳏寡杀所在；地支对应是照生肖说的，书里这里没有写出来。
note.en: The ox, dragon, goat and dog in the four-line rhyme are zodiac animals standing for the branches Chou, Chen, Wei and Xu, the places of the widower-and-widow star in spring, summer, autumn and winter respectively; the book does not spell out the branches here, and they are given by the zodiac.

units.title: 世应相克类：婚姻有疑逃者近

rule.yi: 世应相克的卦，断语是：宅墓高低，生孩子难；病多反复，出行艰难；婚姻有疑虑，逃跑的人就在近处；诉讼拖延，被牵连羁留。
rule.en: For a hexagram in which Self and Other control each other the verse says: with houses and graves high or low, childbirth is hard; illness advances and retreats and travel is hard; a marriage has doubts and the runaway is near; a lawsuit drags on and means being bound and held.

en: House and grave high or low, childbirth is hard;
illness advances and retreats, going and travelling are hard;
a marriage has doubts and the runaway is near;
a lawsuit drags on and means being bound and held.

note.yi: 这首诗在「世应相克」这个小标题下面。「逃者近」按字面译：逃跑的人在近处。
note.en: This verse stands under the small heading 'Self and Other control each other'. 'The runaway is near' is translated literally.

units.title: 总断门：占婚嫌财死，占产看阴阳

rule.yi: 占婚姻，忌财爻死绝；占生产，看阴阳。
rule.en: In a marriage divination, Wealth dead is disliked; in childbirth, look at yin and yang.

en: For a marriage divination, Wealth dead is disliked;
for childbirth, look at yin and yang.

note.yi: 这一句后面原书有今人的注释，本库不引；「死」指财爻在十二长生里死、墓、绝一类无力的位置。
note.en: In the book this verse is followed by a modern gloss, which this library does not quote. 'Dead' means the Wealth line in the death, tomb or extinction stage of the twelve life stages, or a similar powerless place.

units.title: 占来意：旺相则来问婚姻官职，休囚则是争财官退位；卦与世爻同与日则必是六畜及婚姻

rule.yi: 要知道占卜的人为什么事来：先看旺相休囚，旺相是婚姻、官职的事，休囚是争财、丢官的事。卦、世爻和日辰相同的话，来问的一定是六畜和婚姻。
rule.en: To know what the diviner has come about, first look at whether the qi is strong, resting or trapped: strong, it is marriage and office; resting or trapped, it is quarrels over money and an official losing his place. If the hexagram and the Self line are the same as the Day, it must be livestock and marriage.

yi: 要知道占卜的人为什么事来，
旺相就是婚姻、官职的事，
休囚就是争财、丢官位的事
en: To know what the diviner has come about,
first look at whether the qi is strong, resting or trapped;
strong, it is marriage and office;
resting or trapped, it is quarrels over money and an official losing his place

yi: 来问的一定是六畜和婚姻，
en: If the hexagram and the Self line are the same as the Day,
it must be livestock and marriage,

note.yi: 第一段末尾原书有一个「（1）」，是指向今人注释的编号，不在译文里。「卦与世爻同与日」的意思书里没有解释，译文照字面写。
note.en: The book has a '(1)' at the end of the first passage, a number pointing to a modern note, which is left out of the translation. 'The hexagram and the Self line are the same as the Day' is not explained and is translated literally.
